actor_id.description: A natural-person household actor bound to the engine population.

office_id.description: A public-authority entity in the same jurisdiction as the actor.

start_month.description: Inclusive start and exclusive end of this declared appointment.

monthly_principal_basis_points.description:
Percentage of outstanding principal due each month; maturity is a
balloon for any remaining principal. Zero permits interest-only terms.

payment_priority.description: Lower numbers are serviced first; ties use contract ID, not file order.

interest_receivable.description:
Simple interest on principal, kept separate from principal and not
compounded. It is a recorded credit claim even before cash payment.

oneOf.description:
V2 envelope: a sponsoring group may petition, but this public office
must hold the domain's decision authority when the proposal is heard.

V3 envelope. The actor must hold a current appointment to this public
office in the scenario's institution graph, not merely name the gate.

Reassign one domain to another declared public office. The change is
screened by the *current* gate and authority, then takes effect later.

domain.description:
V3 decision provenance. These fields identify declared scenario actors,
not authenticated real-world officials or external model callers.

authority_by_domain.description:
V2 only. The office IDs are declared by institutional gates. Empty in
V1 to preserve its serialized state shape and checkpoint compatibility.

institutional_authority_roster.description: V3 only. Reconstructed and compared with the scenario on resume.

weight.description: Relative political efficacy. No group type has a hard-coded advantage.

jurisdiction.description: A jurisdiction identifier, not a claim that one national law applies.

amendment_surcharge.description: Additional resistance when altering a law or the gate itself.

review_delay_months.description: An accepted change cannot take effect until the next month at earliest.

resistance.description: Extra barrier to policy enactment or alteration of this rule.

Money.description: Fixed-point monetary amount in the scenario currency's minor unit.

basis_points.description: A 100% direct interest is 10,000 basis points.

domain.description: Present only for v3, preserving the serialized v1/v2 state shape.
